description: This file defines build rules, device-specific configurations, and image assembly processes for the OpenWRT build system targeting specific Microchip hardware such as the EV23X71A and Tactical 1000. It includes build definitions for binary files, image creation, device metadata, and packaging instructions.

methods.name: Build/lan969x-fip
methods.description: Concatenates a FIP binary file from staging directory to output.

methods.name: Build/lan969x-gpt-emmc
methods.description: Creates an emmc GPT image with partition tables, copying, padding, and adding binary files.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends kernel partition to the image using dd with specific block size.

methods.name: Device/microchip_ev23x71a
methods.description: Defines the device configuration including vendor, model, SOC, packages, and image composition for the EV23X71A.

methods.name: Device/novarq_tactical-1000
methods.description: Defines the device configuration for the Tactical 1000 including vendor, model, SOC, packages, supported devices, and image composition.
